[Input Data]
- Dish Name (Left Page): {argument name="dish name left" default="Green Curry"}
- Ingredients List (Left Page): {ingredientsLeft}
- Cooking Steps (Left Page): ①{stepLeft1} → ②{stepLeft2} → ③{stepLeft3}
- Dish Name (Right Page): {argument name="dish name right" default="Tom Yum Goong"}
- Ingredients List (Right Page): {ingredientsRight}
- Cooking Steps (Right Page): ①{stepRight1} → ②{stepRight2} → ③{stepRight3}
- Color Theme: {argument name="color theme" default="organic natural colors"}

[Structure and Layout Specifications]
- Style: A flat 2D handwritten-style infographic recipe illustration drawn on a piece of rustic off-white notepad paper (grid paper) with thin grid lines and warm paper texture.
- Background and Composition Constraints: Do not draw physical books, three-dimensional notebook outlines, page thickness, shadows, or realistic photo background elements like wooden tables (Absolutely NO wooden table, NO realistic book mockup, NO book thickness, NO notebook pages, NO realistic photo background. It must be a flat 2D vector layout directly on the textured grid notepad paper canvas).
- Left Side Layout:
  - Large handwritten Japanese title "{dishLeft}" at the top.
  - Below that, the ingredient list "{ingredientsLeft}" drawn with neat vertical bullet points in handwritten Japanese and simple food illustrations.
  - The lower half features cooking steps "①{stepLeft1} → ②{stepLeft2} → ③{stepLeft3}" arranged in a horizontal or vertical arrow flow. Include cute hand-drawn illustrations that match each step's content (e.g., cutting, stir-frying, simmering).
  - A delicious-looking illustration of the finished "{dishLeft}" dish in the bottom left.
- Right Side Layout:
  - Large handwritten Japanese title "{dishRight}" at the top.
  - Below that, the ingredient list "{ingredientsRight}" drawn in handwritten Japanese with simple food illustrations.
  - The lower half features cooking steps "①{stepRight1} → ②{stepRight2} → ③{stepRight3}" arranged in a horizontal or vertical arrow flow. Include cute hand-drawn illustrations matching each step's content.
  - A delicious-looking illustration of the finished "{dishRight}" dish in the bottom right.
- Colors: A gentle, warm organic tone based on "{colorTheme}".

[Quality and Exclusion Constraints (Mandatory)]
- Absolutely no date-related elements like dates (e.g., "8/7"), days of the week (e.g., "SUN"), calendar frames, or date stamps (NO date stamp, NO calendar, NO day of the week, NO timeline stamp).
- Fonts should be friendly handwritten-style Japanese (Gothic or rounded) accurately drawing the input Japanese without distortion or spelling errors.

- Aspect Ratio: --ar 4:3

[Input Data]
- Overall Title: {argument name="main title" default="3-Step Flowchart for Night Shift Introduction"}
- Step 1: Title "{argument name="step 1 title" default="Day Shift Mastery"}" / Period "{step1Period}" / Description "{step1Desc}"
- Step 2: Title "{step2Title}" / Period "{step2Period}" / Description "{step2Desc}"
- Step 3: Title "{step3Title}" / Period "{step3Period}" / Description "{step3Desc}"
- Color Theme: {argument name="color theme" default="green"}

[Structure and Layout Specifications]
- Style: A clean and friendly 3-step flowchart illustration suitable for Japanese business slides, educational manuals, or internal documents. 16:9 landscape slide configuration.
- Background: Clean off-white or solid white background.
- Top Title:
  - Place "Figure 3" or a step badge in the upper left, and to its right, draw a large Japanese main title "{mainTitle}" in a bold, easy-to-read Gothic font. Place a small, clean abstract logo mark at the right edge.
- Step Card Arrangement:
  - Three beautiful rectangular cards arranged side-by-side. Placed in order from left to right, connected by thick arrows. Each card border is color-coded neatly according to the color theme ({colorTheme}).
- Card 1 (Left) Interior:
  - Draw a circular badge "1" and the Japanese title "{step1Title}" prominently. Below that, a capsule label saying "{step1Period}".
  - In the center, place an illustration of a Japanese woman with a gentle hand-drawn touch taking notes, and a window showing the sun.
  - At the bottom, place the Japanese description "{step1Desc}".
- Card 2 (Center) Interior:
  - Draw a circular badge "2" and the Japanese title "{step2Title}" prominently. Below that, a capsule label saying "{step2Period}".
  - In the center, place an illustration of two Japanese women with a flashlight, night sky, and buildings.
  - At the bottom, place the Japanese description "{step2Desc}".
- Card 3 (Right) Interior:
  - Draw a circular badge "3" and the Japanese title "{step3Title}" prominently. Below that, a capsule label saying "{step3Period}".
  - In the center, place an illustration of the night sky and crescent moon, and a Japanese woman smiling with a victory pose.
  - At the bottom, place the Japanese description "{step3Desc}".

[Quality and Font Specifications]
- Simple, clean 2D illustration, flat design, crisp clear line art.
- All text must be accurately drawn in readable Japanese fonts (Gothic) without spelling errors.
- Exclude all 3D effects, shadows, laptop mockup backgrounds, or camera tilt; display the flat diagram itself across the entire screen.

- Aspect Ratio: --ar 16:9

Ultra-detailed 4K cinematic fantasy artwork of a mysterious hooded assassin crouching on the edge of an ancient Japanese-inspired temple rooftop, overlooking a breathtaking mountain city floating above the clouds. He wears an elegant black tactical-ronin outfit with intricate silver embroidery, layered armor, flowing cloak and subtle crimson accents.
He holds an extraordinary katana in one hand, the blade partially drawn and glowing with a subtle electric-blue energy, intricate runes etched along the steel, razor-sharp edge reflecting the moonlight. His face remains mostly hidden beneath the hood, with only faintly visible intense eyes. His cloak and hair flow dramatically in the wind.
Behind him: a gigantic luminous full moon, deep midnight-blue sky filled with stars and dramatic clouds, floating mountains, waterfalls cascading through the clouds, ancient pagodas and glowing lanterns scattered across the valley. Cherry-blossom petals drift through the air, some close to the camera creating beautiful cinematic depth of field.

Create an ultra-realistic high-fashion editorial portrait based closely on the reference image. A glamorous woman stands centered against a seamless vivid crimson-red studio background. She wears a luxurious fitted, floor-length red off-the-shoulder gown with long sleeves, a sculpted neckline, and matching glossy red opera gloves.

Create a surreal artistic illusion of multiple red-gloved hands surrounding and touching different areas of her body: two gloved hands resting elegantly across her shoulders near her neck, another gloved hand placed across her upper waist/abdomen, and another hand positioned across her lower waist. Additional gloved arms extend naturally from behind her body, creating the illusion of a mysterious multi-armed fashion figure. The hands must look anatomically realistic with five fingers each, natural joints, realistic skin/glove folds, and believable positioning.

The woman has sleek, straight, jet-black hair, neatly parted to one side and falling smoothly behind her shoulders. She wears dramatic luxury makeup: deep burgundy-red smoky eyeshadow, softly closed eyes, long defined lashes, sculpted eyebrows, luminous highlighted cheekbones, warm bronzed skin, and glossy deep-red lipstick. Add small elegant gold hoop earrings and a minimal metallic gold choker necklace.

Pose her with a calm, confident, mysterious expression and elegant posture. Keep the composition highly symmetrical and visually balanced. The entire scene follows a monochromatic red aesthetic, with rich crimson tones throughout the dress, gloves, and background.

Lighting: dramatic professional studio lighting, strong directional red light, soft highlights on the face and shoulders, deep cinematic shadows, subtle rim lighting, glossy reflections on the satin fabric and gloves, realistic skin texture.

Photography style: luxury fashion magazine editorial, haute couture campaign, sophisticated beauty photography, cinematic portrait, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the face and clothing, realistic proportions, detailed fabric texture, photorealistic rendering, high dynamic range, ultra-detailed, 4K, premium commercial photography.

Composition: vertical full-body portrait, subject centered, camera at eye level, clean seamless background, dramatic negative space, elegant and polished fashion campaign aesthetic.

Do not change the woman’s facial identity or natural facial proportions if a reference face is provided. Preserve realistic anatomy and consistent facial features.

Negative prompt: deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, malformed arms, duplicated face, distorted face, unnatural anatomy, extra body parts, warped clothing, blurry face, low resolution, plastic skin, cartoon, illustration, text, watermark, logo, cropped head, awkward pose.

营造一种超现实的艺术幻觉：多只戴红手套的手环绕并触碰她身体的不同部位——两只戴手套的手优雅地搭在她颈部附近的双肩上；另一只戴手套的手置于她的上腰/腹部区域；还有一只手则放在她的下腰部。另有戴手套的手臂自然地从她身体后方延伸而出，营造出一位神秘多臂时尚人物的视觉错觉。所有手部均须解剖结构真实，每只手五指齐全，关节自然，皮肤/手套褶皱真实，姿态可信。

该女性拥有一头柔顺笔直的纯黑色秀发，一侧整齐分缝，光滑垂落于肩后。她化有浓烈奢华的妆容：深酒红色烟熏眼影，双眼轻闭，睫毛纤长分明，眉形立体精致，颧骨处带有珠光提亮，肤色呈现温暖的古铜色调，并涂有光泽感十足的深红色唇膏。配以小巧雅致的金色圆环耳饰，以及一条极简风格的金属金色项圈项链。

摆姿要求她神情沉静、自信而神秘，体态优雅。构图须高度对称、视觉平衡。整个画面遵循单色红色美学，礼服、手套与背景均采用浓郁的深红色调。

2122223671018819585.promptEn:
Create a photorealistic high-quality lifestyle portrait of a beautiful young adult woman relaxing on a soft neutral sofa in a cozy modern home. She has long, naturally wavy dark-brown hair, warm fair-to-light olive skin, expressive brown eyes, soft natural makeup, subtle rosy cheeks, and a gentle confident smile. She rests her cheek naturally on one hand while looking directly into the camera.

She wears an oversized cream-white textured knit sweater, light-wash relaxed-fit jeans, delicate small gold earrings, and a thin gold necklace with a tiny pendant. Natural elegant styling, minimal accessories.

Warm late-afternoon sunlight enters from the side, creating soft highlights on her hair and natural skin texture. Background includes a beige sofa, neutral walls, a small vase of white flowers, books, cushions, and a dark doorway, all softly blurred with shallow depth of field.

Photography: realistic DSLR photography, 50mm lens, f/1.8, soft natural window light, subtle cinematic tones, realistic skin pores, detailed hair strands, natural fabric texture, realistic proportions, gentle shadows, professional lifestyle editorial photography, authentic candid feeling, high dynamic range, sharp eyes, 4K detail.

Negative prompt: plastic skin, excessive retouching, artificial face, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, blurry eyes, CGI, cartoon, illustration, oversaturated colors, text, logo, watermark.

Ultra-realistic high-end fashion editorial photo of an elegant young woman posing against a glossy black luxury sedan. She is seated sideways on the edge of the car, with one leg crossed naturally over the other, one hand resting on the car beside her, and her body slightly angled toward the camera. She has shoulder-length softly wavy light-brown hair, delicate facial features, natural makeup, subtle eyeliner, and a calm, confident expression looking directly at the camera.

The black sedan fills the background, with glossy reflections, dark tinted windows, visible door handle and a large premium alloy wheel on the right side.

Minimalist white studio background, soft diffused lighting, realistic skin texture, luxury fashion editorial photography, sharp focus, natural proportions, detailed fabric textures, waist-up composition, 85mm portrait lens, 4K quality. No text, no watermark, no extra fingers, no distorted hands.

A hyper-realistic 8K outdoor photograph of a beautiful East Asian woman , standing three-quarter against a pale concrete wall. Long straight dark-violet hair with blunt bangs, individual strands catching the sun. Round thin metal glasses, fair realistic skin with visible pores, brown eyes, glossy muted rose lips.

She wears a fitted gray ribbed short-sleeve turtleneck; the vertical ribs stretch across the bust with small highlights on each ridge. Matching gray arm sleeves sit below the short sleeves. Black high-waist trousers. Arms crossed loosely in front, one hand resting on the other forearm.

Lighting: hard midday sun from upper left, sharp shadow under the chin and across the torso, thin speculars on the rib-knit and the glasses frames. Soft wall bounce on the right side of the face. Shot on an 85mm f/2, shallow depth of field, photorealistic skin, peach fuzz, knit micro-texture, fashion editorial look.

2122223683081637890.promptEn:
Create a beautiful, cinematic travel photograph of a person sitting comfortably on a small wooden stool in front of a world-famous landmark, creating a detailed hand-drawn artwork of the landmark on a large sketchbook.

The person is seen from behind or at a slight side angle, holding a pencil or colored pencil and carefully sketching the landmark while looking up at the real architecture for reference. An open sketchbook, scattered colored pencils, a few wax crayons, and a small art bag rest beside them.

The landmark is the main attraction: Show the actual landmark prominently in the background, with authentic architecture, accurate proportions, original colors, and recognizable details. The artwork on the person’s sketchbook should closely resemble the real landmark, creating a beautiful visual connection between the artist’s drawing and reality.

Art style: Realistic travel photography blended with a delicate colored-pencil and wax-crayon aesthetic. Visible pencil strokes, textured paper, soft hand-drawn shading, and subtle artistic imperfections.

Atmosphere: Warm golden-hour sunlight, gentle shadows, a peaceful breeze, and a dreamy yet believable travel atmosphere. Include small environmental details that reflect the landmark’s real location and culture.

Composition: Vertical 4:5 format, premium travel magazine cover, the seated artist in the foreground, the sketchbook clearly visible, and the magnificent landmark rising in the background.

Color palette: Warm beige, muted pastels, earthy tones, and naturally vibrant colors inspired by the destination.

The final image should feel artistic, emotional, peaceful, and visually captivating, like a beautiful memory captured while travelling.

Avoid distorted landmarks, fictional architecture, exaggerated fantasy elements, extra fingers, messy compositions, and artificial-looking textures. Keep the person, drawing materials, and landmark natural and realistic.

创作一张美丽、富有电影感的旅行摄影照片：一位人物舒适地坐在一个小木凳上，正对着一处世界著名地标，在一本大型素描本上细致手绘该地标。

人物以背影或略微侧向的角度呈现，手持铅笔或彩色铅笔，一边抬头凝视真实的建筑作为参考，一边专注地勾勒地标。一本摊开的素描本、散落的彩色铅笔、几支蜡笔以及一只小型美术包，静置于其身旁。

地标是画面的核心焦点：在背景中清晰、醒目地展现真实地标，呈现其准确的建筑结构、真实比例、原始色彩与可辨识的细节。人物素描本上的手绘作品应高度还原真实地标，从而在艺术家的画作与现实之间构建出优美的视觉呼应。

艺术风格：融合写实旅行摄影与细腻的彩色铅笔及蜡笔绘画美学。可见清晰的铅笔笔触、纸张肌理、柔和的手绘阴影，以及微妙的艺术性不完美感。

氛围：温暖的黄金时刻阳光、轻柔的阴影、宁静的微风，以及如梦似幻却真实可信的旅行氛围。加入反映该地标实际所在地与文化特征的小型环境细节。

构图：竖版 4:5 比例，高品质旅行杂志封面风格；人物坐于前景，素描本清晰可见，宏伟地标巍然矗立于背景之中。

色彩方案：温暖的米 beige 色调、柔和的粉彩、大地色系，以及源自目的地自然风貌的鲜活色彩。

最终图像应呈现出艺术性、情感性、宁静感与视觉吸引力，宛如一段旅途中的美好记忆被瞬间定格。

避免出现扭曲的地标、虚构的建筑、夸张的幻想元素、多余的手指、杂乱的构图，以及人工感过强的纹理。确保人物、绘画工具与地标均保持自然、真实。","genMode":"text2img"},"children":["$","div",null,{"className":"grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 {
  "vibe_title_en": "Abyssal Archive",
  "master_prompt": "A hyper-realistic, full-body shot of The Protagonist standing in a densely cluttered Maritime Antiquities Vault. The subject is casually reading a thick, weathered logbook, completely detached from the surreal physics occurring around them. In a feat of high-budget practical effects, the protagonist's lower garment is formed entirely of levitating, kinetically splashing saltwater, frozen in time. Within this thick, transparent liquid matrix, several heavy, hyper-detailed silver mackerel are swimming and wrapping around the legs, their wet scales catching specular highlights. The busy environment is a chaotic, hoarder-like archive: stacks of water-damaged navigational charts, piled marble busts, tangled fishing nets, suspended anatomical whale bones, and glass prisms clutter the foreground and background, creating intense depth of field occlusion. Volumetric light leaks through condensation-covered skylights, illuminating swirling dust motes and hanging sea mist. Captured on a Hasselblad H6D-100c with an 80mm f/1.9 lens. Cinematic high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, emphasizing the physical weight of the water droplets, the pores on the subject's skin, and the textured weave of the upper bodice. Kodak Portra 400 film stock, organic film grain, masterful blend of surrealism and elite editorial photography. No neon.",
  "meta": {
    "intent": "Surreal Editorial Photography",

    "accessories": [

2122223691809984513.promptEn: A highly detailed digital painting of an edgy, androgynous young adult character with a confident smirk revealing sharp fangs, set against a solid black background. The character has dark, messy, chin-length hair with a striking {argument name="hair highlight color" default="red"} streak framing the right side of their face, and piercing {argument name="eye color" default="golden-amber"} eyes. They are wearing a crisp white dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, layered under a fitted {argument name="vest color" default="crimson red"} button-up waistcoat, paired with a loose dark necktie. Their lower half features dark grey cargo pants heavily accessorized with multiple black leather belts, silver buckles, eyelets, and hanging silver chains. The character's right arm is raised in a casual flex with a clenched fist, showing prominent pale scars across the forearm, while their left hand rests on their hip. Intricate {argument name="tattoo style" default="geometric and runic"} tattoos cover their neck and left forearm. They wear black nail polish, a feather earring in their left ear, a silver chain necklace, and a beaded bracelet with a feather charm on their left wrist.

On the left side of the paper is a drawing of a clear glass jar with a cork lid. Inside the jar is {argument name="jar contents" default="a green plant with two leaves, a red ladybug on the top leaf, and a tiny wooden house"}. To the right and above the jar, large, bold, black brush calligraphy text reads "{argument name="main text" default="谷雨至 万物生"}". A tiny green sprout is drawn above the text. {argument name="weather element" default="Light blue rain streaks and raindrops fall diagonally"} from the top right. A small red square seal stamp sits near the bottom right of the jar, and a subtle grey wash shadow grounds the jar. At the very bottom center is the handwritten signature "{argument name="signature" default="@Lemao"}".
